tasks.spec: Role: adversarial security reviewer. Review the PEC-78 installed-disabled implementation in ../../../../../../app/command-center/src/lib/pec78, middleware.ts, access-control.ts, env.d.ts, pages/healthz.ts, pages/api/agent/runtime/v1, and schema 188. Compare it to ../pec78-design/security-contract/design.md and ../pec78-design-retry/architecture-contract-retry/design.md. This is phase 1 installed-disabled only: no credential, schedule, provider binding, mailbox read, or outbound effect is authorized. Execute focused tests/build or static checks as useful. Own only review.md. Required headings: Verdict, Scope Reviewed, Executed Evidence, Findings, Phase Decision, Required Next Actions. Use explicit P0/P1/P2/P3 severities, distinguish blockers to installing disabled from blockers to shadow/enabled, and include one machine-readable PASS, FAIL, or CONDITIONAL_PASS verdict. No source edits, network, credentials, or external effects.
tasks.verified: Independent security review classifies installation and activation blockers with executed evidence.
